content.title: See Justin Bieber Bring Out Billie Eilish, SZA at Second Coachella Show
content.text: Skip to main content See Justin Bieber Bring Out Billie Eilish, SZA at Second Coachella Show Sexyy Red, Big Sean, and Dijon also stop by during singer’s Weekend Two headlining gig Justin Bieber at Coachella on April 18 Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for Coachella Justin Bieber welcomed a bunch of surprise guests during his second headlining set at Coachella, including Billie Eilish and SZA. A week after the singer brought out the Kid Laroi, Tems, Dijon, and Wizkid at Coachella, Bieber returned to the stage with an even more stacked guest list: First out was Sexyy Red, who assisted on the live debut of the Swag track “Sweet Spot.” During the now-dubbed YouTube portion of the set, Bieber launched into his “One Less Lonely Girl,” with the accompanying video playing on the giant screens. Midway through the track, Billie Eilish was lured out of the crowd and crawled onto the stage, with Bieber serenading her for the remainder of the performance: Eilish’s cameo was notable as that singer has frequently cited Bieber — and their first encounter at Coachella 2019 — as an inspiration. The pair previously linked up on a remix of Eilish’s “Bad Guy.” Trending Stories Next out was Big Sean, who joined Bieber for “As Long as You Love Me” and “No Pressure.” Dijon also returned to perform “Devotion,” and SZA capped things off to perform her own “Snooze” during the headlining set; Bieber previously guested on that song when SZA performed at Los Angeles’ SoFi Stadium in May 2025: https://twitter.com/Frxmzy/status/2045774277044060610 The Coachella gigs marked the only shows currently on Bieber’s tour schedule, though fans are speculating the singer could be on the verge of announcing his first trek since his Justice World Tour, which ended abruptly in September 2022 after the singer was diagnosed with Type 2 Ramsay Hunt syndrome.
